argument.script: async (intermediate) => { const groups = []; const sidebar = document.querySelector('[class*="_side"]') || document.querySelector('[class*="_main_mmtyp"]'); if (!sidebar) return groups; const items = sidebar.querySelectorAll('div[class*="woo-box-flex"]'); let foundCustomGroup = false; for (const item of items) { const txt = (item.innerText || '').trim(); const lines = txt.split('\n'); const name = lines[0]; if (name === '自定义分组') { foundCustomGroup = true; continue; } if (name === '管理' || name === '') continue; if (name === '悄悄关注') break; if (foundCustomGroup && name && name.length < 20) { groups.push({ name }); } } return groups; }
